basic_info.name: TP-CLAP (Text-Prompted CLAP) — parameter-efficient CLAP extension with query-conditioned audio representations via cross-attention prompt fusion
basic_info.org: Authors: Mohan Li, Rama Doddipatla, Philip C. Woodland — Toshiba Research Europe Ltd + University of Cambridge (the co-authors' known affiliation) [uncertain: exact affiliation in paper not verified]
basic_info.links: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25085 -- no public code/checkpoint found [uncertain]

architecture.backbone: Base CLAP model augmented with lightweight cross-attention-based fusion module injecting textual prompts into audio features; base audio/text encoder identity not extracted from paper [uncertain]
architecture.input_modality: audio + text prompts (English questions used as conditioning)
architecture.training_objective: Stage 1: trained with the audio multiple-choice question answering (AMCQA) framework — the query-conditioned audio embedding is trained to align with the text embeddings of correct answer choices via contrastive learning (stays fully compatible with the original CLAP objective). Stage 2: fine-tuned for attribute-focused audio-to-audio retrieval with an audio-to-audio contrastive loss computed between the text-conditioned embedding e_f and the UNCONDITIONED embedding e_a (so only one embedding per track needs to be stored for retrieval). Fine-tune data: NSynth (instrument family, pitch, instrument source; 870K pairs) and MagnaTagATune (genre, instrument, tempo; 24K pairs); 30 epochs, lr 5e-5, batch 512/256
architecture.embedding_output: Global CLAP-style embedding; text-conditioned embedding is dynamic per prompt (audio x question), the unconditioned embedding is a fixed single vector per clip; embedding dim inherited from base CLAP [uncertain]; no frame-level output

data.training_data: AMCQA training data + classification data annotated with multiple attribute dimensions for fine-tuning: NSynth 870K audio-attribute pairs, MagnaTagATune 24K pairs; licenses not stated in extracted material [uncertain]

performance.benchmarks: Audio question answering: competitive with much larger audio-LLMs despite compact size. Conventional audio-text retrieval: improves base CLAP. Zero-shot classification: improves base CLAP. Attribute-focused audio-to-audio retrieval on NSynth test (Precision@K, mAP) and MagnaTagATune test (SoftPrecision@K, SoftmAP) — text-conditioned TP-CLAP beats the unconditioned embedding across ALL evaluated attributes and metrics
performance.vs_clap: Improves the base CLAP model on audio-text retrieval and zero-shot classification, and consistently outperforms the standard CLAP baseline in attribute-focused music retrieval; exact deltas not extracted [uncertain]

fit_for_local_playlist.sample_rate: Not stated in extracted material; inherits base CLAP convention (16 kHz assumed) [uncertain]; needs resampling from repo-standard 48 kHz mono [uncertain]
fit_for_local_playlist.inference_cost: Added module is lightweight/parameter-efficient; base CLAP-scale model size; no per-track latency or memory published [uncertain]
fit_for_local_playlist.full_track_context: HTS-AT/CLAP-style fixed clip encoding assumed [uncertain]; no long-context support stated; whole tracks need windowed inference [uncertain]
fit_for_local_playlist.frame_level_support: No — prompt conditioning operates at the global clip embedding, no frame-level API [uncertain]
fit_for_local_playlist.retrieval_steering: Core contribution — text-prompted steering: audio representations adapt to a requested attribute (genre, mood, instrumentation, tempo, pitch, speaker emotion, acoustic environment); supports attribute-focused audio-to-audio retrieval where retrieved items share the requested attribute rather than overall similarity
